subject: Cobalt Matrix exec demo — CIO + VP attendance and deep-dive request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltmatrix.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request — CIO + VP on demo next week?

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro last month. Rajiv (our CIO) and Priya (VP of Platform) expressed interest in a demos that show production economics — latency, quantization tradeoffs, and rollout controls. Can we schedule a 60–75 minute session where: 1) Rajiv sees the executive pitch (15–20m), 2) a technical deep dive covering latency/quantization + architecture (30–40m), and 3) time for questions + procurement next steps (15m)?

Top constraints: Rajiv is only available next week on Tuesday (11/23) after 1pm PT or Friday (11/26) between 9–11am PT. We need VP attendance if possible. Also, procurement (Nina) will want a follow-up with SSO/KMS and SOC2 evidence — I can loop her in once we lock time.

Recording is fine as long as live execs consent. We are evaluating for a Q1 commit; this is the main RFP short list demo.

Looking for your availability and recommended run-of-show.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Cloud Architecture
Cobalt Matrix

[Attachment: Cobalt_Requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltmatrix.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — CIO + VP on demo next week?

Liam — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can absolutely run that agenda. Proposed options (all PT):

- Tue 11/23 13:30–14:45 (exec intro + tech deep-dive)
- Fri 11/26 09:00–10:15 (compressed, keeps exec + deep-dive)

Marissa, can you confirm VP availability for either slot? Ben, I'm looping you as backup for the architecture segment and to own the follow-up procurement packet.

Run-of-show (high level):
1) 15m Executive intro — value, topline economics, example production SLOs (Aditya)
2) 35m Technical deep-dive — serving runtime, routing/fallback, latency bench, quantization tradeoffs + demo of failure mode (Marissa + Ben)
3) 15–25m Q&A + procurement next steps (all)

I'll attach our latest demo deck — it's tuned for a CIO/VP audience but includes an appendix with kernel/latency numbers. Can you share a pointer to any specific latency or throughput targets Rajiv wants us to demonstrate? Also, confirm if we should keep the deep-dive in-hosted demo or mirror it to a Private (VPC) environment — both have different setup notes.

Attaching: Redwood_Demo_Deck_v3.pdf

Aditya Rao
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0176

[Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Deck_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cobaltmatrix.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — CIO + VP on demo next week?

Looping in VP availability and a couple of practical notes.

Hi Liam — quick notes from Priya's office (VP, Platform): she can make the Fri 11/26 09:00–10:15 PT slot but prefers the 11/23 afternoon if it were earlier (12:30–13:45) — which I know is tight for Rajiv. If Rajiv is fixed at 1pm on 11/23, let's take Tue 1:30 but Priya asked she be marked as "lead exec" for the solution conversation (short intro, then hand to Ben for arch).

Regarding run-of-show detail and ask list:
- Exec intro: focus on production economics and fallback behavior (keep to 15m)
- Deep-dive: include a 10m live trace showing a cold-start KV-cache miss and how routing falls back to quantized model (Ben will demo)
- Procurement: Nina will need SOC2 scope, retention windows, and KMS/HSM notes; if you can pre-send the procurement one-pager we can reduce the follow up to 15m.

Recording/consent: we will ask Rajiv live. If they prefer no recording for the deep-dive, Ben can run the architecture demo in a prerecorded segment to keep details consistent.

Ben, can you prepare a 10-slide appendix covering: latency by seq length, quantized vs FP16 throughput, and canary rollback time? Also link to the HubSpot record for Cobalt so we can capture outcomes: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/COB-4721

Thanks — locking Fri 11/26 09:00 as our fallback unless Rajiv confirms the Tue window.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cobaltmatrix.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@cobaltmatrix.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — CIO + VP on demo next week? — Confirming Fri 11/26 09:00 PT

Thanks — Fri 11/26 09:00–10:15 PT works for Rajiv and Priya. Nina (procurement) is on the thread to take the procurement checklist. A couple of asks before we lock calendar: 

1) Can Ben expand the deep-dive to include a short section (10m) on quantized model behavior for 8-bit int runtimes — Rajiv wants to see latency/accuracy tradeoffs live.
2) We need a short privacy/retention note in the procurement packet: specifically whether KV cache persists across restart and the default retention window.
3) Please send the DocuSign for the NDA / data processing addendum (we'll route through Nina).

If you're good with the agenda we'll send a calendar hold; please include dial-in + recording consent checkbox on the invite.

Looking forward to it — this is the primary short-list demo for our Q1 infra decision.

Best,
Liam
